surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves the use of nitrogen plasma and trimethylaluminum precursors. The deposition consists of four stages: 0.02s trimethylaluminum dose, 7s Ar gas purge, 10s N2/5% H2 plasma, followed by another 7s Ar purge. The plasma power was set to 600 W (13.56 MHz).
